name: cinematic-status-board
title: Rolling slate status board (cutscene set prop)
usage: Broken Relay cutscenes: Sera's board beside the radio desk; the game adds the three plain name strips (Teal's lit) in front of the slate. Pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded. Dormant slot in src/: RobloxAssetIds entry undefined, so the cinematic keeps its procedural prop until approval and upload.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, writing or glyph-like marks: the slate is plain dark green with soft chalk-dust smudges; the game's name strips are blank colour bars.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No maker's marks; plain aluminium frame and dark painted stand.

noFaces.note: No faces or figures; a plain rectangle on a two-post stand with three thin horizontal strip ledges.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary office/workshop board in every view.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: A status board: no weapons, damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

orientation: Slate face at Roblox -Z; the marker tray is in front of it, the uprights and rear brackets behind it.
design: Original rolling status board: a dark green slate in an aluminium frame with a marker tray and three thin strip ledges, on two dark uprights with wheeled feet and a crossbar.
sizeRationale: Slate 5 x 3.2 x 0.25 studs centred 7.6 above the floor, the procedural board's envelope; anchors.Board is the slate centre (the procedural BOARD point, desk-relative (12.5, 7.6, 2.5)). The game keeps its name strips 0.15 in front of that point.
